items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Well, is Magnapol still with the old happy band? Yeah, he's still with them. Because I worked with them the week before that, at the Roseville Hotel.

ctx.x: And Richardson's got out of the union for a week. So that's about it. Right. At least the old one.
Well, is Magnapol still with the old happy band? Yeah, he's still with them. Because I worked with them the week before that, at the Roseville Hotel. Well, half the town they have two jobs.
Yeah, well, they'll have different guys from the Tuxedo. They use Knox and Trotta.
